• GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten or gelatin; Each serving has a good source of vitamin C for snacks you can feel great about

  • FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Fruit by the Foot Variety Pack featuring Berry Tie-Dye and Strawberry Tie-Dye flavors; With wild flavors and colors, the possibilities for fun are endless

  • FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snacks are an ideal treat to include in a packed school lunch box

  • ON THE GO: These fruit flavored snacks are ribbons of fun - the perfect addition to your pantry and a snack every member of the family will love

  • CONTAINS: One Value Pack box of Fruit by the Foot Fruit Flavored Snacks, 12 Ct, 9 oz
features:
Features

Variety of flavors: Includes fun and colorful rolls in flavors like Berry Tie‑Dye, Blue Raspberry, and Strawberry Tie‑Dye.

Individually wrapped: Convenient, portable packs—perfect for school lunches, after-school snacks, or on-the-go treats.

Gluten- and gelatin-free: Made without gluten or gelatin, making it suitable for many dietary needs.

Added vitamin C: Fortified to provide a good source of vitamin C in every serving.

Fun presentation: Long, rollable fruit strips make snacking playful and interactive, especially for kids. 

 Benefits

Kid-friendly appeal: Bright colors, fruity flavors, and the "unroll and eat" format make them a favorite among kids.

Convenient for parents: Pre-portioned and mess-free—easy to toss into lunchboxes or backpacks.

Better-for-you snack: Provides some nutritional value with vitamin C and no gelatin, as a more mindful sweet treat option.

Low in fat: Each serving is low in fat and contains moderate calories, making it a lighter snack option.

Vegetarian-friendly: No gelatin means it’s suitable for vegetarians or families with dietary preferences.
